scientific_question: Under ideal finite-source convergence, per-view elevation and roll, and declared known calibration heterogeneity, does the exact nine-view parallel operator A0 plus a small equal-factor-count Kronecker correction approximate the straight-ray operator Ag well enough that surrogate detector-CR K4 with one exact Ag-transpose lift remains matched to exact Ag CGLS K4 on the frozen probes?
evidence_role: small dense known-geometry compressibility and Krylov-transfer gate after the v61 algebra and v62.2 resource passes; it may authorize a target-scale matrix-free implementation but cannot itself establish target-scale speed, calibrated-camera transfer, curved-ray transfer, operator learning, real BOST, generalization, or paper success

seen_before_freeze: The v61 small parallel-ray operator had exact rank-one detector-normal Kronecker blocks and roundoff K4 replay.
The v62.2 16x16x32 parallel-ray analytic detector-normal implementation reproduced full K4 vectors at roundoff and reduced the 101-call fresh-process outer p50 relative to Zero-CGLS K4.

A two-view 4x4x4 unit test confirmed that the new orthographic builder matches the existing parallel builder, the finite-source builder is finite and adjoint-consistent, a constructed rank-one residual is recovered, and exact detector-CR matches CGLS.

Independent mathematical review identified equal-total-term fairness, internal-versus-true residual separation, global positive-semidefinite construction, and small-oracle scope as mandatory P0 corrections; these corrections were applied before protocol freeze.

A second pre-result audit required exact probe formulas, an A0 rank-one certificate, per-block and global factor counts, a fixed chained-kernel ledger, source-closure hashes, an expected-atom barrier, stable harm denominators, and separation of q selection from C20 confirmation; all were added before v63.1 freeze.
The formal runner decision helpers, cached-factor path, exact CR factor action, deterministic probes, Lanczos implementation, and expected-atom logic passed 13 focused tests before v63.1 freeze.

Before the v63.1 freeze, no formal v63 geometry matrix, singular spectrum, random action metric, K4 metric, scenario decision, independent validation, target-scale timing, or memory result had been computed.

The v63.1 runner later completed all 13032 atoms and returned FAIL_SMALL_ORACLE_KNOWN_GEOMETRY_CORRECTION_V63; q=1,2,4 all failed selection and the residual family was not distinctly better than standalone.

The v63.1 package was mechanically invalid because checksums.sha256 included the transient RUNNING.json that was deleted before completion. All numerical tables and the negative decision were seen before v63.2 freeze.

The only v63.2 change is excluding RUNNING.json from the immutable checksum set and deleting it before checksum generation. Geometry, probes, matrices, factorization, q, controls, metrics, gates, aggregation, and decision code are unchanged.

No PoolFire trajectory, BLASTNet field, validation trajectory, fresh trajectory, stopping-validation trajectory, untouched test, experimental image, group-private data, or VPN content is read.
No neural model is trained or authorized.

factorization_contract.standalone_family: best rank-q SVD approximation of Ag after the frozen rearrangement
factorization_contract.parallel_residual_family: A0 plus the best rank-(q-1) SVD approximation of Ag-A0 after the same rearrangement
factorization_contract.detector_normal: Btilde=Atilde Atilde-transpose assembled from the same global Atilde factors
factorization_contract.maximum_detector_pair_terms_at_budget_q: q squared per source-target view-component pair
factorization_contract.q8_role: diagnostic ceiling only; q8 cannot authorize a target-scale speed claim

probe_contract.coordinate_grid: z,y,x each use numpy.linspace(-1,1,n), meshgrid indexing=ij
probe_contract.support_projection: set the outermost voxel plane on all six faces exactly to zero before normalization
probe_contract.normalization: divide every field by its float64 Euclidean norm after support projection
probe_contract.random_field_distribution: 17 independent float64 numpy default_rng(2026073063) standard-normal voxel fields, then support projection and normalization
probe_contract.observation_generation: noise-free y=Ag*x_truth; no perturbation, clipping, or normalization is applied to y
probe_contract.A_action_probes: all 17 random supported fields and all five structured truths
probe_contract.B_action_probes: 17 independently normalized default_rng(2026073163) standard-normal detector vectors
probe_contract.finite_difference_gradient: numpy.gradient on the z,y,x volume with spacing 2/(n-1) on each axis and edge_order=2, stacked in z,y,x order
probe_contract.residual_family_ratio_floor: comparison ratios use (residual_metric+1e-14)/(standalone_metric+1e-14) before the geometric mean

mild_geometry_continuation.selection_and_confirmation_rule: choose the smallest q that passes all q-selection scenarios and the residual-family distinct-value gate; evaluate only that chosen q on C20_plus and C20_minus; a failed confirmation closes the route and cannot select a larger q
mild_geometry_continuation.authorizing_arm: Btilde detector-CR K4 followed by one exact Ag-transpose lift; Atilde-transpose lift is a required non-authorizing control

residual_family_distinct_value.comparison: parallel-residual versus standalone at the same total term budget q
residual_family_distinct_value.aggregation_unit: the two stabilized dimensionless ratios for K4 field difference and true Ag residual difference at every eligible scenario-probe cell

formal_execution_contract_v63_1.source_closure: hash protocol, core, and runner before execution and reject completion if any byte changes
formal_execution_contract_v63_1.expected_atom_barrier: before building A0, enumerate and hash every legal operator-action, approximation-summary, control-replay, candidate-replay, and scenario-gate atom; READY requires exact set equality, no duplicates, no missing cells, no unexpected cells, and no non-finite numeric values
formal_execution_contract_v63_1.scenario_execution: one controller processes scenarios serially; one exact Ag, one cached pair of per-block standalone/residual SVD families, and one Atilde at a time
formal_execution_contract_v63_1.factor_cache: retain every singular value but only the first eight left/right singular vectors; each scenario performs exactly two SVDs per view-component block and no SVD while materializing q
formal_execution_contract_v63_1.small_oracle_detector_kernel: each Btilde action is executed as Atilde@(Atilde.T@v); no explicit q-squared pair expansion is executed
formal_execution_contract_v63_1.deployment_ledger: K4 reports four chained Atilde and four chained Atilde-transpose actions plus one exact Ag-transpose lift; it separately reports 4*(18*q) theoretical forward and transpose factor-term actions
formal_execution_contract_v63_1.evaluation_ledger: true residual evaluation adds one exact Ag forward and is not deployment cost

formal_execution_contract_v63_1.exact_controls: exact detector-CR versus exact CGLS is reported for every scenario and every truth probe, although only G0 roundoff enters the formal pass decision
formal_execution_contract_v63_1.dual_nullspace_boundary: exact Ag-transpose lifting need not remove the nullspace of Atilde-transpose; formal output must keep the Atilde-transpose control, and independent validation must add a range-projected-dual diagnostic before a final PASS may be issued

pass_requires: G0 exact controls pass at roundoff.
The smallest q at or below four that passes every q-selection scenario and every probe is selected without consulting C20.
That one selected q passes both C20 confirmatory scenarios; failure cannot select a larger q.
The parallel-residual family demonstrates distinct value over the standalone family at the same q during selection and confirmation.
The internal and true residual are separately reported and satisfy the frozen online-use boundary.
Global Btilde symmetry and positive semidefiniteness are generated only from one Atilde factor set.
Independent validation reproduces every formal decision.

next_if_pass: Implement the same frozen q in a 16x16x32 matrix-free factor path, include q-squared detector-normal term cost, and run a fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS gate before any learning. A deterministic known-geometry correction takes precedence over a neural model.
next_if_fail: Stop the detector-Kronecker geometry-transfer route. Compare sparse calibrated Ag, streaming Ag, and geometry-aware PCGLS; do not enlarge a neural model to rescue failed known-geometry compressibility.
